feature: Issue 189: see the same live queue across tabs and operators

userStories.title: Queue snapshot route and shared reconciliation primitives
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a mutation-free GET queue snapshot route plus shared generation/reconcile/focus/poll primitives, so that every node-room dock can later hydrate and converge on the authoritative registry queue without races or per-poll event-history reads.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/workflows/runs/:runId/nodes/:nodeId/queue returns 200 { success: true, queued: [{ message_id, message }] } containing only the handle's pending items in receipt order for live AND parked handles; drained/withdrawn ids and accepted-id memory never appear on the wire

Every route outcome (200, 401, 404, 409, 422, 500) carries Cache-Control: no-store, set by method-guarded pre-gate middleware that returns the nested 401 steering shape when auth is required with no resolved identity and calls next() for non-GET methods so DELETE is unaffected

Successful hot-path read performs exactly one run lookup + synchronous registry get + one snapshot(): no workflow-event, message, pending-interaction, or run-write store calls; a code comment cites the close-before-terminal executor invariant (dag-executor.ts ~3290-3568, ~5669-5674, ~6868-7119)

Error ladder verified by tests: unknown run/node 404; terminal run, terminal projected node, and closed handle 409; known non-terminal node without in-process handle 422; store exception logs api.workflow_node_queue_read_failed with only { err, runId, nodeId } and returns nested 500; no success logging and no queued-message text in serialized log output

Actor matrix: starter, another authenticated member/admin, and auth-disabled solo caller all get 200; gated unauthenticated caller gets nested 401 before generic API middleware; steeringValidationErrorHook is registered via registerOpenApiRoute

Schemas added after withdraw schemas in packages/server/src/routes/schemas/workflow.schemas.ts (readWorkflowNodeQueueParamsSchema strict {runId,nodeId}, queuedGuidanceMessageSchema .openapi('QueuedGuidanceMessage') with z.string().uuid() message_id, readWorkflowNodeQueueResponseSchema .openapi('ReadWorkflowNodeQueueResponse'), type via z.infer only); public contract _bmad-output/specs/spec-agent-node-room/steering-api-contract.md documents GET request/response/errors/no-store/parked-readable/read-vs-mutation races

packages/web/src/lib/api.generated.d.ts regenerated via openapi-typescript against this worktree's live server (additive diff only, never hand-edited); readNodeGuidanceQueue(runId, nodeId, { signal }) helpers added in packages/web/src/lib/api.ts and packages/web/src/experiments/console/skills/runs.ts with URL-encoded segments, GET + cache:'no-store', optional AbortSignal, failures normalized through toSteeringSendError(), no auto-retry; Console helper uses requestJson and does not import @/lib/api

SteeringDockState.queueGeneration starts at 0; resolveGuidanceSuccess increments on every resolved active submission including idempotent receipt replay; matching resolveWithdrawSuccess increments even when a snapshot already removed the row; begin/failure/stale no-op transitions never increment

applyQueueSnapshot returns identical object on generation mismatch; otherwise replaces sent wholesale with server-ordered 'queued' receipts preserving inFlight/pendingRetry/refusal/withdrawingMessageId/queueGeneration; identical ids+text+order returns identical object; never touches draft/sessionStorage and never clears a refusal

focusTargetAfterSnapshot returns null when nothing focused or the focused id survived; on removal picks nearest surviving next id in previous order, then previous id, then field, skipping siblings removed by the same snapshot

startQueuePolling reads immediately, captures generation before each read, schedules the next read only after settle (never overlaps), normalizes throws/rejections via toSteeringSendError(), retries silently on 422/status 0/status>=500 without calling onSnapshot, stops without onSnapshot on other 4xx, and stop() aborts the active signal + clears pending timer + suppresses all late callbacks with no retry after abort

Focused tests pass: (cd packages/server && bun test src/routes/api.workflow-runs.test.ts) and (cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/steering-dock.test.ts) covering all 12 server cases and all 12 shared-library cases listed in phase-01-start.md
Full gates pass: bun run type-check, bun run lint --max-warnings 0, bun --filter @archon/server test, bun --filter @archon/web test
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow phase-01-start.md exactly. Route registration beside send/withdraw in packages/server/src/routes/api.ts; reuse mockSteerableRun/steerEvent/queueSteerItem test fixtures. Generated types: check port 3090 ownership first, never kill another session's process, verify /api/openapi.json contains the GET path + both named schemas before regenerating, then release only the recorded PID. Do not modify registry, executor, DB, OpenAPI validation hook, send/withdraw wire behavior, or deps. Note: empty path segments do not match the router — assert the validation hook is registered rather than fabricating an unreachable params test.

userStories.title: Both docks hydrate and reconcile the shared queue
userStories.description: As an operator viewing a node room in either shell, I want my dock to hydrate the shared queue at mount and converge every second, so that remote sends/withdrawals appear in correct order while my unsent draft, retry state, refusals, detached disclosure, and focus are preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: ComposerDock.tsx and ConsoleComposerDock.tsx export type ReadNodeGuidanceQueue and accept optional props readQueue (defaulting to the shell's helper — @/lib/api for Legacy, ../skills/runs for Console) and pollIntervalMs (default 1000, narrow deterministic test seam only)

dockRef.current = dock kept current during render; poller captures queueGeneration from it; pollingEnabled computed only for existing composer and blocked modes — hidden historical/terminal rooms and send-triggered detached disclosures never read

One effect keyed by runId, nodeId, readQueue, pollIntervalMs, pollingEnabled calls startQueuePolling({ read: signal => readQueue(runId, nodeId, { signal }), currentGeneration: () => dockRef.current.queueGeneration, onSnapshot, intervalMs: pollIntervalMs }) and returns the stop function; dock object is NOT in the dependency list

onSnapshot captures the focused row id from deleteButtonsRef before render, calls applyQueueSnapshot inside functional setDock, returns immediately without touching pendingFocusRef on same-identity, and on applied removal of the focused id sets pendingFocusRef to focusTargetAfterSnapshot(previousIds, nextIds, focusedId) only when the ref is null — existing post-commit effect performs DOM focus and a local withdraw target wins

Each queue <li> gains data-message-id={receipt.messageId}; keys, accessible names, sent text, list/header/status copy, classes, target sizes, and DOM order unchanged; STEERING_SEND_HINT remains 'Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to send · this tab only' with no tab-only label in the queue band

Ten mirrored component cases pass in BOTH suites (ComposerDock.test.tsx and ConsoleComposerDock.test.tsx): hydrate on mount with two rows in exact server order + data-message-id + queued · 2 + zero send/withdraw calls; remote convergence adds/removes rows with no observer DELETE; stale read after local send keeps the local row; stale read after local withdraw does not resurrect the row; focused remote removal moves focus next then to textarea and never <body> including multi-row removal skip; remote snapshot leaves textarea draft and sessionStorage byte-for-byte unchanged; 422/status-0/500 rejections preserve queue+refusal and reschedule with no detached alert; 409 stops reads leaving UI unchanged; unmount/scope change with pending read produces no late state/focus updates; live={false} never reads and send-triggered detached state stops reading
Test render helpers inject a default non-settling read promise so all pre-existing send/withdraw tests stay deterministic with no real fetch

NodeTranscriptPane.test.tsx and ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx install spyOn(globalThis,'fetch') returning real JSON Response { success: true, queued: [] } only for GET pathnames ending /queue, rejecting every other URL/method, restored in afterEach; no production-only read prop threaded through parents

Markup assertions confirm band is sibling above padded composer with surface-elevated + top border, list wrapper keeps max-h-[33vh] + overflow-y-auto, rows one-line/end-elided, delete controls keep >=24px targets/focus class, field/hint/control markup and tab order unchanged

Behavior unchanged: send/withdraw responses update immediately; existing refusals stay visible; send 422 still swaps to detached disclosure preserving draft/retry id; Ask-blocked mode renders shared queue but refuses local send; no loading placeholder/animation on hydration
packages/web/src/experiments/console/console-isolation.test.ts remains green (Console imports helper from ../skills/runs only)

Validation passes: the four focused component/parent test files under NODE_ENV=development, bun --filter @archon/web test, bun run type-check, bun run lint --max-warnings 0, then bun run build:web and (cd e2e && npx playwright test -c playwright.config.ts --grep '\[V:steer\.detached-') to prove the existing detached send-triggered contract is unchanged
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow phase-02-both-docks-read-and-reconcile-the-shared-queue.md. Re-read both components/tests first — US-001 changed imported shared types. Match the parent transcript's current-state ref + serial-poll AbortController cleanup precedent. Do not modify NodeTranscriptPane.tsx, ConsoleNodeRoom.tsx, CSS, or isolation config; keyed mounts already exist. Do not rewrite the existing detached Playwright scenario. Mutating pendingFocusRef inside the updater is limited to deterministic ref assignment — DOM focus stays in the existing post-commit effect.

userStories.title: Multi-view E2E evidence and Story 2.9 closeout
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want real-browser proof that tabs and operators converge on the same ordered queue with scope isolation and no regressions, plus an acceptance report and tracker closeout, so Story 2.9 can be marked done with evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: e2e/fixtures/workflows/e2e-queue-guidance-pair.yaml created: two independent e2e-fake/e2e-fake-model nodes steer-a and steer-b, no depends_on, <<E2E_SCENARIO>>{"delayMs":45000}<</E2E_SCENARIO>> directive with $ARGUMENTS, mutates_checkout: false; archon-runtime.ts gains fixture path + exported E2E_QUEUE_GUIDANCE_PAIR_WORKFLOW_NAME and both node ids + one seed write beside existing queue workflows; no existing fixtures/scenarios changed

e2e/ui/agent-queue-convergence.spec.ts added with journeys parameterized over console and legacy, each creating its own run/contexts/pages with unique messages, explicit context close + request-listener disposal in finally, unique evidence filenames (worker-scoped runtime is NOT test-scoped — no fresh server/db per test)

Journey [V:steer.converge-${surface}]: starterA+starterB in one starter context and teammate context at 460x900; getRunDetail() proves viewer_is_starter true/false; typed drafts draft-alpha/draft-beta verified in fields and scoped sessionStorage; starterA queues starter-one-<tag> and all three DOM lists + starter GET + teammate GET converge to [starterId]; teammate queues its draft and all observations converge to [starterId, teammateId] with QUEUED · 2, exact id/text/order, no duplicates; starterB focuses starterId's delete button, starterA withdraws via keyboard, all views + both server identities reach [teammateId], starterB issued zero DELETEs and focus lands on teammateId's delete; teammate withdraws, all observations reach [], no QUEUED band remains, starterB focus lands on composer field not <body>, draft-alpha intact; observer starterB issued zero DELETEs for the whole journey

Journey [V:steer.scope-${surface}]: own pair run; both steer-a and steer-b node_started + direct GETs 200/empty; page A on node A queues A-only, page B on node B queues B-only; converge to [aId]/[bId] with no id/text leakage; navigate A->B hydrates exactly [bId], back to A exactly [aId], page B stays [bId]; proves route key + keyed remount/scope reset

Synchronization rules honored: never wait on the next GET response (may predate mutation); expect.poll on complete DOM id array via data-message-id and on server queue via identity-bearing request contexts requiring exact { success: true, queued: [...] } shape; POST/DELETE response waiters armed before the triggering action to capture accepted message_id and status/body

Helpers adapted (not exported) from agent-queue-guidance/agent-withdraw-guidance specs: openGuidanceRoom, roomRegion, guidanceField, queueList, rowDeleteButton, waitForNodeStarted, captureEvidence, expectNoRoomDrivenOverflow; added queuePathname + encoded send/delete builders, rowIds, readQueue, expectQueueIds/expectServerQueueIds via expect.poll, per-page method/path request counters with disposal, active-element + no-overflow measurements; geometry helper records queue wrapper computed max-height and asserts production max-h-[33vh] class

Visual evidence captured at two-row and one-row convergence for both shells at 460x900 and Console additionally at 1440x900 (same ordered state visible in simultaneous views), plus final layout after band disappears and scope-journey split state; screenshots named with journey+shell+viewport+state and attached to Playwright output; band is full-bleed surface-elevated above inset composer, says QUEUED · n, no this-tab-only copy, rows one-line/elided with named native delete controls, 33vh scroll boundary, no horizontal overflow

Unique per-test JSON measurements recorded under plans/260919-1418-issue-189-live-queue-across-tabs/reports/evidence/: tag/run/node, both ids, ordered ids per view+identity, GET/DELETE counts per page, draft-storage values, active elements before/after each removal, viewport/overflow facts; no shared mergeMeasurements() read/modify/write

reports/acceptance.md created only after tests pass, mapping each of the four Story 2.9 Given/When/Then groups (epics.md ~669-695) to Playwright test ids + shells, the Phase 1-2 focused tests covering race/error/focus behavior, screenshot/measurement filenames, and validation commands+results; no destructive red-run-on-develop claim; no repeating the route error ladder or provider-drain tests already owned elsewhere

Validation order executed: bun run build:web; (cd e2e && npm run typecheck); new spec alone; all steering scenarios (cd e2e && npx playwright test -c playwright.config.ts --grep '\[V:(steer|withdraw)\.') ; bun run validate — all green (regenerate/rebuild + rerun affected tests if types or bundle changed during repair)
After all gates pass, sprint-status.yaml changes ONLY 2-9-see-the-same-live-queue-across-tabs-and-operators from backlog to done; unrelated stale 2-1 entry untouched

userStories.technicalNotes: Follow phase-03-two-tab-e2e-evidence-and-closeout.md. Live window discipline: create contexts/pages BEFORE dispatch, keep assertions inside the 45s fixture window, terminal disappearance = test failure. Use starterA.request/archon.starterFetch and teammate.request (identity headers) for server reads — ids+order are the contract, never text/count alone. If E2E exposes a product defect, fix it in the owning Phase 1/2 file with its focused test first; this phase owns no product behavior. Do not update design source hashes (no pinned design source changes).
